description: Total your workspace's priced calls over a period, this calendar month by default: requests, units, compute time, cost, cached and prepaid calls, and the part of this month's cost still to be billed. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: End of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to now.

start_date.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601. Defaults to the first of this month.

name: get_usage
